core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mikaeel corresponds to the Arabic form ميكائيل (Arabic مِيكَائِيل (Mīkāʾīl)). Its core sense is michael; an archangel's name. Mikaeel is Arabic مِيكَائِيل (Mīkāʾīl), the name of the archangel Michael, mentioned in the Qur'an. The source gloss 'Who is like God?' is the traditional Hebrew etymology of the name and is broadly consistent. Same name as mikail.
